programme.desc: The History and Mystery of the Englewood Hershey. Delve into the enigmatic history and spectral mysteries of the Englewood in Hershey, Pennsylvania. programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.sub-title: New Hope Railroad and Monmouth UFO
programme.desc: The Eric Mintel Investigates team travels to New Hope PA to Investigates the haunted New Hope RR station. Shadow figures, weird knocks and sounds plus electronic disturbances have made this investigation one of the most mysterious the team has encountered. Jazzman and Paranormal Investigator Eric Mintel and Bill Birnes star of Ufo Hunters and Ancient Aliens meet with retired IT director and program manager Joe Foster. Joe recounts his UFO experiences from 1958, 1970 and 2002. Joe, as quarter master in the Coast Guard, had several UFO sightings in the service.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.sub-title: Plumsteadville Inn and UFO Report from Doylestown, PA
programme.desc: Bucks County Paranormal Investigations was called in to investigate the beautiful and historic Plumsteadville Inn, Pipersville, PA. Lead investigator Eric Mintel joined by Dave Antonow, Dominic Sattele and Spirit Medium Karen T. Hluchan roamed the halls of this historic structure and encountered many paranormal energies. A discovery, unknown to the owner Matt George, made this investigation one of BCPI's favorite in Bucks County. Follow the clues as we unravel the Mysteries of the Plumsteadville Inn. Also, Eric gets a report of a recent UFO sighting by a woman in Doylestown PA that was not only excited by what she saw but also frightened by it. Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele meet with Leslie and talk about her report and try to find clues as to what it could be. What follows is a journey into the unknown as more UFO reports ramp up in the same area. What are people seeing!? Eric Mintel Investigates: UFO's over Doylestown PA.
